summary.en: The Detective Boys inform that there have been rumours about flavour change in Ramen restaurant “Ogataken”, so they, Conan and Haibara come to the restaurant to verify this. Ogataken has been opened for 32 years by Masashi Ogata and now it is run by him and Kosaku Ogata, his son. In addition, this restaurant also has signatures from famous people who came here to eat and commented that it was delicious.
